purpose: High-quality synthetic tourism sentiment corpus for LR/SVM/BETO V4, targeting mixed praise-then-failure failures without replacing historical V1–V3 artifacts.
target_note: 5001 = 1667 families × 3 labels; nearest ternary-balanced size to the requested 5000.
role_note: Role counts are families, not rows. hard_holdout never enters fitting, tuning or classical calibration.

leakage_controls: entire family stays in one role

hard_holdout_design.intended_global_label: negativo for failure endpoint; matched neutral/positive twins share family skeleton

beto.truncation_finding: Measured 2026-11-25: praise-prefixed failure (206 BETO tokens) predicts positivo at max_length=128 because transporte/reclamación are dropped; same text predicts negativo at 256.

beto_notes: Prefer frozen encoder or last-block adaptation over full fine-tune if VRAM pressure appears.
Keep batch_size small (2–4) for 256-token sequences on 6 GB.
